title: Hearty Dense Mexican Pork Rajas Con Crema
description: A rich and indulgent Mexican dish featuring pork, Thai green curry paste, and a yuzu cure, served in a mason jar as rajas con crema.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine Thai green curry paste, yuzu juice, and a pinch of salt, blending until smooth.
Rub the curry paste mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, searing the pork shoulder until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork to the oven, braising for 2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded.
While the pork is cooking, saute the diced onion and bell pepper in a pan until softened.
Once the pork is done, shred it with two forks and stir in the sauteed onion and bell pepper mixture.
In a separate saucepan, heat the heavy cream over low heat until warmed through.
Stir in the shredded monterey jack cheese until melted and smooth.
To assemble the rajas con crema, place a layer of the pork mixture in the bottom of a mason jar, followed by a spoonful of the cream sauce.
Repeat this process until the jar is full, finishing with a layer of cream sauce on top.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
